# Vox 2.0.6 — a Vox home, not an Apple Music clone

The first two passes of the interface overhaul: Home carries its own voice, and the bottom bar gets out of the way while you scroll.

## Home identity

- Chillax sets the display type for the masthead, section headers and tile titles; Plus Jakarta Sans carries everything you read.
- The glass is gone from scrolling surfaces: warm obsidian and paper with a single 1dp hairline at 12% white. Blur is reserved for static modals, so scrolling no longer pays for it every frame.
- Top Picks is a full-bleed cover with the title underneath over a dark scrim, instead of artwork with type baked into the image.
- Section headers get a champagne rule, and "SEE ALL" is uppercase champagne.
- Chips are outlined when idle and solid champagne when selected.
- The mic and shuffle discs no longer overlap Music Videos — they sit in one docked capsule that hides on scroll.

## Nav and mini player

- The mini player is no longer squeezed into the middle of the tab bar between Home and Search.
- Scroll down and the tab bar folds into one floating circular Search button on the right while the mini player expands into the space it left; scrolling back up unfolds it.
- Everything animates on a single 380 stiffness / 0.85 damping spring, with the player clipped rather than scaled, so text and icons never warp.
- Long-press the mini player for a lifted preview: dimmed backdrop, a single cached 20dp blur, artwork, title, artist, a live scrubber, the current lyric, previous/play/next, and a stacked menu for Favorites, Add to Playlist, Go to Album/Artist, Share and Listen Together.
- On Home the top bar no longer repeats the page title under the masthead.

## Install

- Download `vox-2.0.6.apk`, allow installs from your browser or file manager, and open it.
- This is a debug build signed with the debug key — uninstall any earlier copy first.

## Notes

- ABIs: `arm64-v8a` and `x86_64`. A 32-bit-only phone needs the arm32 flavour.
- The in-app updater reads `updater.json` on this release, so updates work from inside the app from here on.
